title: Ergonomic Slippers – Thick-Soled for Indoors & Outdoors
descriptionHtml:
Tired feet after a day at home? Then they're the wrong slippers.

Thin, flat slippers work against you – every step lands hard on heels and knees. You don't notice right away. You notice in the evening.

The solution: like walking on clouds

Thick, shock-absorbing sole that cushions every step and relieves joints and back. Comfortable indoors – and non-slip enough for the patio and the yard.

Features

  • Relieves knees and back – thick shock-absorbing sole
  • Non-slip indoors and outdoors
  • Dries quickly – light and airy
  • Unisex in several sizes
  • For home, patio and summer cottage

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
